image.data-name: Original beautifully crafted 16-bit pixel art background for a retro videogame title screen, widescreen 16:10 composition. Dreamy sunset over a quiet layered city skyline, with a spacious calm soft muted lavender sky in the upper central half. Crisp square pixels and stair-stepped edges, low resolution art enlarged with nearest neighbor, intricate deliberate pixel clusters, absolutely no smooth digital painting. Large sculptural fluffy cumulus cloud banks frame the left and right edges of the sky, creamy peach highlights, blush pink illuminated rims and lilac magenta shadows, pastel dusty lavender violet sky graduating into peach pink at the low horizon. Small pale golden setting sun on the far right near the horizon. Three layered silhouettes of urban apartment rooftops and skyscrapers occupy the bottom quarter only, distant lavender buildings behind dusty plum buildings behind deep midnight purple foreground rooftops, antennas, water tanks, sporadic tiny warm gold and pink square windows. The center of the sky is open and uncluttered, with clouds mostly to the sides. Rich nostalgic atmosphere, delicate scattered square stars, magical tranquil sunset, color palette #CBC5EA #FF8FA3 #C96FD8 #FFD166 #1F1828. Edge to edge environment artwork only, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no UI, no characters..jpg
